name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
archDisplay: Hybrid Mamba-2 / Transformer MoE (512 routed experts per MoE layer), 120B total / 12B active, with a C-RADIO vision encoder and multi-token prediction; 1M-token context
note: NVIDIA's open vision-language Nemotron, released October 15, 2026 alongside Nemotron 3.5 Bolt: a 120B-total / 12B-active hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE with a C-RADIO vision encoder and a 1M-token context, under OpenMDW-1.1, in BF16 and NVFP4. Served through NVIDIA NIM and OpenRouter; NVIDIA sets no first-party token price. NVIDIA's NeMo Gym table puts it below Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and GLM-5.3-Flash on most agentic rows (Terminal-Bench 2.1 66.7 vs 85.8 and 82.7). NOT FILED: rows marked [offline] in the table (BrowseComp offline, WebVoyager, AA-Briefcase-Lite, AutomationBench-AA, GDP.pdf, Terminal Bench 4, DeepSWE) are non-standard offline runs; GDPval-AA v2 (1211) is on AA's re-based scale; HLE text-only (31.79) is a subset (the full-set 29.20 is filed); MMLU-ProX, AA-Omniscience, CritPt, APEX shortlist, AA-LCR, GraphWalks, LMArena v3 proxy, WMT24++, BabyVision, MMLongBench-Doc, V*, OCR-Reasoning, OCRBench v2 and Video-MME v2 have no matching corpus column.
